_doc: Commits where ε_rel (precond_delta_relative=True) runs are specifically
buggy, while non-ε_rel runs at the same commits are valid. This is the
JSON home of the legacy BUGGY_EPS_REL_COMMITS registry.
When a group is MIXED (some ε_rel cells, some default-δ cells) a
commit-level exclusion would also kill the good default-δ cells. This
registry is per-(commit, ε_rel=True) so the mixed-group case stays whole.
Note: the broader invariant `lambda_max_fix_for_eps_rel` in invariants.py
(requires_ancestor=9677abe) captures the same intent and more — every
ε_rel run must be a descendant of the λ_max fix. The commits listed here
are pre-9677abe; they should be caught by that invariant. This JSON is
preserved for behavioral equivalence and to allow tightening / loosening
